# Security Prompts

Stops AI assistants from shipping the vulnerability that made the error message go away.

**41 prompts.** Install the whole category bundle:

```
Please fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bentheautomator/free_ai_prompts_that_dont_suck/main/install/security.md and append its contents to my project instructions file.
```
